environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on bare EC2 instance, connecting directly to PostgreSQL 15 via pgBouncer in transaction pooling mode. No WAF or API gateway in front. The app_user database role has full SELECT privileges on all tables in the public schema. pgBouncer configured with pool_mode=transaction and max_client_conn=100.

config.network: Direct internet-facing ALB with no WAF, passthrough to port 8080
config.db_user_privileges: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_user
